question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

211, 158, 187, ?, 163, 110, 139
solution:
The pattern followed here is :

**The difference between consecutive odd terms is -24 & the difference between consecutive even terms is -24.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a65b24a5edd7958412b2e7db0dad750fb793b24167d50711feb3eab2e787079d.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** Option 4.**
